description: Samantha Kumara Madawanna Arachchi v. Urban Development Authority and Another Samantha Kumara Madawanna Arachchi v. Urban Development Authority and Another View More before Hon. Upaly Abeyrathne, J.
parties: Samantha Kumara Madawanna Arachchi v. Urban Development Authority and Another Samantha Kumara Madawanna Arachchi v. Urban Development Authority and Another View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought to quash the appointment of the inquiring officer in charge of the disciplinary proceedings initiated against him, on the basis that appointing a retired police officer as the investigating officer violated the Establishment Code. Held - The Petitioner had initially willingly participated in the inquiry without objection, and the filing of this Application was delayed and premature. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
